limitations: One smoke sample per task, fresh chat/worker per task; no fine tuning or prompt adaptation. External cloud arm uses its own full catalog. These runs do not establish a speedup.

All ten requests hit the existing client 90-second limit; no completed response supplied token counts or a model-selected action. The windows/get_windows execution in each trace is the existing harness initial perception, not a model selection.
Fresh chat and native worker per case share one Ollama process/model cache; first load is cold and later cases can reuse cache.
